meta.name: security-research
meta.description: Team Mode security research skill. Orchestrates 3 vulnerability hunters and 2 PoC engineers to audit a codebase in parallel, prove exploitability, classify root causes, and calibrate severity by actual exploitability. Use for security review, vulnerability research, exploitability audit, pre-release security check, threat model validation, and `/security-research`. Triggers: 'security-research', 'security research', 'security review', 'vulnerability audit', 'exploitability audit', '보안 리뷰', '취약점 감사'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码库交给多名漏洞猎手和验证工程师并行审查,找出真正可利用的缺陷并定级。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果发布前想确认代码里没有被忽视的可利用漏洞。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to confirm exploitable flaws before shipping.

howto.what: Claude 会拉起 5 人团队(3 名漏洞猎人 + 2 名 PoC 工程师)并行审计代码库,复现漏洞证明可利用性、区分 CWE 根因,并按实际可利用性定级,最后给出 PASS/BLOCK 结论的报告。
howto.when: 当你说出 “security review”、“vulnerability audit” 等触发词,或要做发布前安全检查等审查时接管;需 team_* 工具可用且在主会话。

say.text: 用 security-research 审计当前仓库的安全敏感面
say.note: 会组建 5 人并行审计团队

say.text: 对这个 PR 的改动做可利用性审计,给出 PoC
say.note: 产出带证据与最小修复的报告

say.text: 发布前安全检查:只做本地非破坏性验证
say.note: 不跑破坏性利用,用静态或干跑证明

howto.what_en: Claude spins up a 5-member team (3 vulnerability hunters + 2 PoC engineers) to audit a codebase in parallel, prove exploitability, keep CWE root causes separate from severity, and return a report with a PASS/BLOCK verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say “security review”, “vulnerability audit” and similar phrases, or ask for a pre-release security check; requires team_* tools in the main session.

say_en.text: Use security-research to audit the security-sensitive surfaces of this repo
Audit this PR diff for exploitability, with PoCs
Pre-release security check, local non-destructive only
say_en.note: No destructive exploits; static or dry-run proof
